experiences.learnerPromise: See tokenization and sampling mechanics directly before reasoning about larger AI systems.
experiences.productionDecision: Understand representation and generation mechanics; no incident framing is needed.
experiences.ahaMoment: Model inputs and outputs are constrained by token-level mechanics rather than human text boundaries.
experiences.migrationAction: Keep the current route and playground as an optional Foundation node. Do not promote it as a flagship Campaign step.

experiences.learnerPromise: See why finite working context forces explicit selection and budgeting.
experiences.productionDecision: Choose what information deserves scarce working-context budget.
experiences.ahaMoment: A larger context window does not remove the need for context policy.
experiences.migrationAction: Keep as a compact Foundation playground linked from Context concepts, not as a required Campaign incident.

experiences.learnerPromise: Manipulate a bounded Agent loop and see why iteration needs termination and recovery policy.
experiences.productionDecision: Trade completion, retries and stopping behavior before side effects become consequential.
experiences.ahaMoment: An Agent loop is a control system, not an unlimited sequence of model calls.
experiences.migrationAction: Keep as optional Loop foundation. The consequential retry lesson now belongs to The $47,000 Retry.

experiences.learnerPromise: Diagnose why an Agent cites stale evidence even though current evidence exists.
experiences.productionDecision: Ship a retrieval/evidence policy that balances freshness, authority, grounding, latency and context cost.
experiences.ahaMoment: Retrieval quality is a pipeline property; more context is not better evidence.
experiences.migrationAction: Mission conversion completed. Keep the indexed route and stable lab_id; use additive missionId for new gameplay semantics.

experiences.learnerPromise: See how compression saves working context while risking loss of critical evidence.
experiences.productionDecision: Choose a compression policy that preserves consequential information under a fixed context budget.
experiences.ahaMoment: Compression quality is about retained decision-critical evidence, not token reduction alone.
experiences.migrationAction: Compression mechanics are consumed by The Broken RAG Pipeline and Final Boss. Keep this route as a specialist sandbox/reference; remove it from the primary Campaign sequence.

experiences.learnerPromise: Stabilize a runtime where timeout and retry duplicate an irreversible refund.
experiences.productionDecision: Balance recovery, idempotency, approval, latency and cost before reopening traffic.
experiences.ahaMoment: Retry policy and idempotency policy are one reliability design problem.
experiences.migrationAction: Mission conversion completed. Keep route, lab_id and paid-intent event; new Mission lifecycle events remain additive.

experiences.learnerPromise: Stop untrusted content from acquiring authority over real Agent capabilities without blocking useful work.
experiences.productionDecision: Design trust, permission and runtime enforcement boundaries under false-positive pressure.
experiences.ahaMoment: Prompt injection is a trust/capability-boundary failure, not merely bad prompt wording.
experiences.migrationAction: Mission conversion completed. Preserve route and lab_id; keep security policy semantics outside localized visible text.

experiences.learnerPromise: See how dataset coverage, uncertainty and vetoes change a release decision.
experiences.productionDecision: Decide what evidence is strong enough to justify shipping.
experiences.ahaMoment: A positive aggregate score is weak evidence when critical slices or vetoes fail.
experiences.migrationAction: Keep as an Evaluation prerequisite/reference linked near the Final Boss. Do not add another flagship Evaluation incident in v0.8.

experiences.learnerPromise: Compare orchestration topologies and expose coordination/failure-propagation costs.
experiences.productionDecision: Use graph complexity only when decomposition creates measured value.
experiences.ahaMoment: More agents and coordination do not automatically create a better system.
experiences.migrationAction: Keep as an optional Graph prerequisite/reference for Final Boss. Preserve public route and telemetry; remove from primary incident sequence.

experiences.learnerPromise: Own the final production launch decision for a flawed Support Agent under bounded engineering budget.
experiences.productionDecision: Inspect evidence, choose bounded cross-layer interventions, compare attempts, then defend SHIP, BLOCK or INCONCLUSIVE.
experiences.ahaMoment: Production readiness is a system property and critical vetoes cannot be averaged away.
experiences.migrationAction: Upgrade current six-layer Build into #89 Final Boss using the shared Mission Engine while preserving the indexed route and capstone lab_id.
